invariants.invariant: Recovery dispositions survive the Agentd boundary
invariants.scope: Typed conversion and real product ingress; target host pending

invariants.invariant: A stale witness cannot admit a post-commit restart
invariants.scope: Real child exit / SQLite; fixture authority only

invariants.invariant: A possibly published or unresolvable candidate is retained as indeterminate
invariants.scope: Real Linux directory-fsync injection through the public recovery entry; selected-host filesystem qualification pending

invariants.invariant: Revocation prevents later writes without rewriting committed history
invariants.scope: Signed and live-verifier fixtures; independently administered signer pending

invariants.invariant: Re-admission uses a fresh grant-bound writer generation
invariants.scope: Repository restart/rotation; selected-host rollback pending

invariants.invariant: History and tombstones survive reopen without treating deletion as erasure
invariants.scope: Measured owner history; pruning and physical erasure not claimed

invariants.invariant: Current source and all required execution records are independently checked
invariants.scope: Exact source objects, no inherited success

invariants.invariant: Signed bootstrap source identity matches the trusted deployment before recovery
invariants.scope: Direct source identity check; deployment attestation remains external

invariants.invariant: Authority is rechecked before recovery pointer publication
invariants.scope: Real SQLite final-use revocation and unchanged predecessor; native execution pending

invariants.invariant: Normal host read pages preserve exact cut without a mutable escape
invariants.scope: Actual host API and normal features; fixture authority, not deployment evidence

invariants.invariant: API denials require successful positive compilation controls
invariants.scope: Default, host-unified and qualification visibility; not runtime authorization or OS isolation

invariants.invariant: A current-cut witness leaves the exact SQLite owner image and existing sidecars private and identity-stable for descriptor recovery
invariants.scope: Owner-controlled DB/WAL/SHM/journal identity; selected-host filesystem qualification pending

invariants.invariant: Release recovery reports wait, held time and sampled resource growth separately
invariants.scope: Three recoveries per profile; sampled lower bounds and fixture-verifier cost, not host SLO acceptance

invariants.invariant: Expired grants do not prevent recording authenticated terminal evidence
invariants.scope: Operational records only; expired admission and reactivation remain denied

invariants.invariant: Every declared storage owner signs its exact lifecycle obligation with a unique evidence identity
invariants.scope: Real Ed25519 verification with fixture keys, per-obligation evidence uniqueness and plan/inventory disjointness; owner attestations are not independently observed physical erasure

invariants.invariant: Encrypted cold archives preserve the exact owner cut and never authorize pruning or activation
invariants.scope: Bounded encrypted full-history cold-generation transfer; native execution and independently managed archive/restore acceptance remain separate; hot pruning and physical erasure not claimed

invariants.invariant: Lost archive or restore responses are observed without replay or adoption
invariants.scope: Current independently signed observation authority; original operation may be expired; readable bytes do not prove past publication durability

invariants.invariant: Signed input reads are nonblocking and bound to the current pathname
invariants.scope: Real POSIX FIFO, replacement, link, mode and byte-limit regressions; not a deployment isolation claim

invariants.invariant: Only the committed plan, per-command template identity, resolved workload and test threshold can satisfy qualification
invariants.scope: Canonical whole-plan and raw-entry digests plus real command runner in disposable Git repositories; exact production candidate and native matrix remain separately required

invariants.invariant: Publication observation pins scratch identity and rechecks the created image at final use
invariants.scope: Real encrypted codec and filesystem; native checker mocked in protocol tests; no replay, hot pruning or erasure authority

invariants.invariant: Selected-host receipts bind one coherent cut, fresh grant-bound writer generation and distinct receipt/evidence/metrics identities
invariants.scope: Real Ed25519 fixture receipts, cut/generation/grant chains and downstream-visible unique receipt/evidence/metrics identities; actual selected-host execution and acceptance remain external

invariants.invariant: Retention readiness binds owner-attested disjoint ranges, complete aggregates, an unpublished same-cut rebuild and distinct receipt/evidence identities
invariants.scope: Signed range/data/manifest/receipt/evidence identities with owner separation and final-use ordering only; publication, pruning and erasure remain unclaimed

invariants.invariant: Independent acceptance validates exact plan-entry identities, coherent evidence contents, globally unique operational/review evidence and ordered approvals without effects
invariants.scope: Real Ed25519 fixture approvals plus manifest-v3 whole-plan/entry bindings, source-head/merge/host/retention/lifecycle validation, cross-domain evidence uniqueness and final-use trust checks; actual reviewers and release execution remain external

externalEvidence: Independent signer governance and retained current-cut witness outside the rollback domain.
Trusted reconciliation of a commit-to-witness publication gap, without deriving authority from a suspect backup.
Selected-host directory-fsync fault injection, canary, restart, rollback and SLO receipts.
Independent review, operator acceptance and release approval.
